articles.summary: FeSiB microwires use optimized magnetic bias and end oxidation to stabilize resonance in liquids. Water–glycerol tests relate resonance to hydrodynamic loading, with reported liquid quality factor above 17,000. This directly informs magnetic viscosity readout, but density–viscosity cross-sensitivity and biological fluids still need validation.

articles.title: Optimization design of a single-layer self-shielded coil in a nanocrystalline magnetic shielding helmet for wearable magnetoencephalography
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A target-field model and multiobjective optimization co-design a self-shielded coil and magnetic helmet. Simulations address uniformity and leakage, while active tests check residual-field suppression. The work informs wearable magnetometer environments, without establishing unconstrained ambulatory MEG.

articles.title: A hierarchically layered porous PDMS-based pressure sensor with an ultrawide detection range
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A modulus and porosity gradient drives progressive deformation through three PDMS layers. The sensor reports one fitted pressure response across 0–660 kPa and 5,000-cycle durability. The architecture informs range–sensitivity design, without establishing clinical pressure accuracy.

articles.title: Asymmetric flexible nanocomposite hydrogel with dual-modal sensing for decoupled strain and vibration monitoring in human motion
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: An asymmetric hydrogel separates resistive deformation and piezoelectric vibration channels. Sedimented ceramic particles create the functional gradient in one compliant body. Wearable demonstrations support channel separation under tested motions, without full six-axis force reconstruction.

articles.title: A biomimetic setaria viridis interlocking structure for wearable piezoresistive sensor with high sensitivity
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Interlocking coated textile fibres concentrate stress at distributed contacts. The resulting resistance signal supports motion, sound and spatial-pressure demonstrations. The contact architecture is relevant to tactile textiles, without evidence for universal calibration across garments.

articles.title: Enhanced signal fidelity in wearable pressure sensors via geometrical confinement of inverted microdome architectures
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Recessed microdomes constrain deformation and limit frictional micro-slippage in a conductive composite. The device captures pulse features and tactile maps with improved signal fidelity. Geometric shielding is directly relevant to motion artefacts, without establishing complete shear-force rejection.

articles.title: Biodegradable, stretchable poly(lactic acid)-based piezoelectret force sensors with parallelly-arranged air cells for soft bioelectronics
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Air-cell PLA piezoelectrets combine stretchability with pressure and tensile response. Wearable and underwater demonstrations accompany about 40,000 cycles. The prototype still uses non-bioresorbable aluminium electrodes, so complete in-body resorption is not demonstrated.

articles.title: Multi-material direct ink write of PDMS/BTO/CNC flexible piezoelectric composites for wireless sensing applications
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Multimaterial direct writing integrates piezoelectric composite and compliant electrodes in one fabrication step. The measured composite reaches 11.67 pC/N, with Bluetooth transmission of human-motion signals. This manufacturing method is transferable, without implanted wireless-power validation.

articles.title: AgNPs/TPU flexible piezoresistive sensor with multilevel biomimetic microstructures inspired by dermal papillary layer for wearable applications
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Mesh-templated electrospinning and silver reduction form hierarchical conductive microprotrusions. Pressure tests extend to 120 kPa with motion demonstrations. The method informs scalable tactile structures, without proving chronic silver-contact safety.

articles.title: Flexible ferroelectric pressure sensor
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: This review compares ferroelectric pressure sensors across materials, electrodes and architecture. It emphasizes hierarchical stress modulation and sensitivity–linearity trade-offs. The synthesis directly informs soft transducer design, without introducing new measured device performance.

articles.title: In-situ poled magneto-mechano piezoelectret nanogenerator for self-powered electronics
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A porous PVDF–nickel-oxide structure couples charge trapping with mechanical and magnetic responses. The reported magnetoelectric coefficient reaches 2.4 mV/(cm·Oe), with substantial response without external DC bias. This informs compliant magnetic–mechanical conversion, without demonstrating a remotely powered implant.

articles.title: Frequency dependence analysis of planar spiral flexible magnetic sensor made of conductive polymer composite
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A conductive-polymer spiral sensor shows strongly frequency-dependent magnetic response. Impedance analysis links a crossover to capacitive pathways, and inverse filtering reconstructs complex signals. The work directly informs magnetic calibration, without proof of frequency-independent or deep-tissue performance.

articles.title: Flexible resistive tactile sensor with high-sensitivity and high-linearity based on a double-layer sandpaper structure and nanocomposites for wearable electronics
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Hierarchical sandpaper-like structures combine elastomer deformation and nanotube tunnelling. The pressure response remains nearly linear to 360 kPa, with 5,000-cycle tests. Structural linearization is useful for tactile calibration, without a demonstrated clinical monitoring outcome.

articles.title: An anisotropic LIG-PEEK strain-sensing fiber for multidirectional bending detection in wearable human-machine interfaces
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Laser-written graphene on PEEK fibres yields opposite resistance polarities for opposite bending directions. An orthogonal two-channel arrangement distinguishes at least four directions within an approximately 1-mm fibre. This directly informs sparse directional readout, while gesture accuracy remains specific to the tested dataset.

articles.title: Analytical and experimental study of a rotational frequency up-conversion piezoelectric energy harvester with stoppers-based mode shape switching for self-powered wireless sensing
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Mechanical stoppers switch a rotating piezoelectric beam between modes to up-convert excitation frequency. Experiments reach 1.977 mW at 360 rpm and support intermittent wireless transmission. The nonlinear harvesting method is transferable, without equivalent output under body motion.

articles.title: A fully wearable smart face mask for respiratory monitoring based on a thermo-hygroscopic sensor fabricated by fused deposition modeling
articles.readingBasis: Official indexed abstract/summary; 12 healthy participants with static and dynamic comparisons; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A printed carbon-filled polymer sensor replaces a mask valve and streams respiratory data wirelessly. Twelve healthy volunteers show static rate errors no greater than 1.25 breaths/min and dynamic errors below 2.5 breaths/min against a reference belt. This directly informs motion-tolerant breath wearables, without clinical disease validation.

articles.title: Corrugated liquid-metal-based pressure sensing with single-regime linearity over an ultrabroad range
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A corrugated liquid-metal path elongates and thins progressively during compression. Geometry yields a single linear resistance regime to 1.35 MPa with 20,000-cycle stability. This directly informs wide-range tactile transduction, without proving calibrated multi-axis force sensing.

articles.title: Photonic integrated chip for wearable physiological and biochemical sensing
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A polymer photonic chip integrates resonators, interferometers and microfluidics for wearable measurements. The abstract describes physiological and chemical sensing functions but gives no quantitative validation details. The integration concept is relevant; blood-pressure or glucose diagnosis should not be inferred from the abstract alone.

articles.title: A particle dynamics-based soft sensor for simultaneous estimation of flow rate, viscosity, and density in microfluidic channels
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Camera-tracked particle motion jointly estimates microchannel flow, viscosity and density. Temporal and inter-particle attention exploit motion variability, with accuracy depending on the active-particle fraction. The method directly informs inverse fluid sensing, while operating conditions must remain within the validated particle-dynamics regime.

articles.title: Plant-wearable microneedle sensor for real-time monitoring of L-glutamate dynamics
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A glutamate-oxidase microneedle follows local glutamate in living tomato stems. Tests distinguish operational stability from storage retention and record stress-related dynamics. The local biochemical interface may transfer methodologically, without human interstitial-fluid validation.

articles.title: Wearable SERS patch integrating spatially functionalized no-core fiber taper for versatile off-body and in-situ sweat biomarker monitoring
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Spatially separated regions of a fibre-taper SERS probe measure glucose and lactate in a sweat patch. Mixture tests and activity demonstrations support reduced spectral crosstalk. This directly informs multiplex readout; in-situ lactate estimates remain semi-quantitative.

articles.title: Implantable dual-fluorescence perivitelline microsensors for monitoring temperature and pH dynamics during early embryo development
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Calibrated fluorescent microspheres track temperature and pH near cultured mouse embryos. Implantation causes a detectable reduction in eight-cell-stage progression, and cleavage-associated temperature changes need further physical controls. The work informs localized dual-parameter sensing, without established developmental safety.

articles.title: Gate-sensitive field-effect transistor based all-2D heterostructure for ultra-fast and wireless breath acetone monitoring
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A catalytic floating gate is separated from a graphene channel by a two-dimensional dielectric. A wrist-worn wireless prototype detects breath acetone with rapid response and thirty-day component stability. This informs remote chemical transduction, without proving acetone is interchangeable with blood glucose.

articles.title: A competitive displacement-enabled wearable aptamer sensor with femtomolar sensitivity monitoring of urinary lysozyme
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Target binding displaces a redox-labelled probe in a reagent-free urine aptamer sensor. A dendritic microfluidic collector supports small healthy-volunteer and diaper demonstrations. The architecture is transferable, while nine-volunteer comparisons do not establish renal-disease diagnosis.

articles.title: Geometry-engineered PI–paper microfluidic interface for passive biofluid renewal and long-term wearable biosensing
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Laser-patterned polyimide pores couple a hydrogel chamber to capillary paper drainage. Human glucose tests extend mean operating cycles from 31.0 to 50.5 and reduce three-hour MARD from 31.47% to 15.25%. Passive renewal directly addresses continuous-sensor drift, but this is not proof of multiday accuracy.

articles.title: A wearable hydrogel-gated microfluidic platform for simultaneous sweat-ion sensing and flow-threshold discrimination
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A hydrogel-gated sweat chip combines three ion-selective channels with outlet threshold electrodes. It distinguishes six nominal flow thresholds while measuring ionic responses. This adds flow context to wearable chemistry, without continuous quantitative flow-rate measurement.

articles.title: Molecularly imprinted wearable sensor based on in situ growth of gold nanowires on PET nanoporous film for rapid cortisol detection
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Nanoporous PET templates gold nanowires supporting a molecularly imprinted cortisol interface. Artificial-sweat tests and healthy-volunteer observations include circadian and sleep-related states. This directly informs longitudinal hormone monitoring, without validated stress or disease diagnosis.

articles.title: A low-crosstalk piezoresistive sensor array fabricated by hybrid laser 3D printing and laser-induced graphene for tactile perception on flexible surgical robots
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Laser printing and porous graphene integrate spatially separated tactile cells on a flexible surgical robot. Curved supports reduce mechanical coupling while preserving conformity, supporting navigation and lesion-mimicking palpation. Several indexed numerical fields are missing, so no crosstalk or classification values are reconstructed.

articles.title: Wearable micromotor-based electrochemical microneedle sensors for monitoring tumor biomarkers in skin
articles.readingBasis: Verified official indexed abstract/summary; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Dissolving microneedle cores release self-propelled, antibody-functionalized magnetic carriers into sampled interstitial fluid. Active capture is followed by magnetic enrichment and electrochemical detection in a tumour-bearing animal model. This directly links microrobotics and biosensing, without establishing human cancer screening or proven continuous operation.

articles.title: Author Correction: Accelerated intestinal wound healing via dual electrostimulation from a soft and biodegradable electronic bandage
articles.readingBasis: Official accessible text read; SI not read
articles.summary: This correction revises how Young's modulus was estimated in an earlier biodegradable electronic-bandage study. It clarifies fits to resampled subsets rather than three independent repeats. The distinction matters for mechanical uncertainty, and the notice supplies no new healing results.

articles.title: Tracking-free mean square displacement analysis of molecular dynamics
articles.readingBasis: Deposited abstract/short description in Crossref or Europe PMC; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: Image-derived mean-square displacement uses intensity autocorrelation rather than linking individual trajectories. The protocol extracts diffusion, confinement and object-size information from time-lapse microscopy. This informs reconstruction under crowding or low signal-to-noise, while temporal resolution remains imaging-dependent.

articles.title: Black-hole system: in vivo continuous bioligand-assisted elimination of circulating tumor cells to prevent cancer recurrence and metastasis
articles.readingBasis: Deposited abstract/short description in Crossref or Europe PMC; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: An extracorporeal microfluidic reservoir captures circulating tumour cells during continuous pumped blood withdrawal and return in mice. The system combines affinity surfaces, tubing and flow handling. It offers a model for blood-contact microsystem integration, without demonstrating autonomous implanted operation or clinical benefit.

articles.title: Plasmonic nano-candle platform for phase-resolved optical tracking of Pd hydrogenation with structure-sensitive readout
articles.readingBasis: Deposited abstract/short description in Crossref or Europe PMC; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A palladium–gold nanoarray combines resonance shifts and transmission changes during hydrogenation. Modelling links these signals to dielectric changes and effective gap evolution. The coupled chemical–structural readout is transferable, but the abstract's damaged response-time field is not reconstructed.

articles.title: Large-scale quantitative assessment of tissue preparation and staining conditions for robust multiplexed imaging of FFPE tissue samples
articles.readingBasis: Official article abstract/preview; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: A multisite benchmark tests 24 preparation and staining combinations for multiplex tissue imaging. A 27-marker panel measures intensity, variability and marker failure across laboratories and platforms. This informs reproducible biochemical readout and technical controls, without claiming a new continuous sensor.

articles.title: Tracking local chemomechanics in graphiteâsilicon composite electrodes
articles.readingBasis: Official article abstract/preview; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: This official brief highlights how operando imaging relates local ionic pathways to electrode activity. It comments on a companion battery chemomechanics study. The measurement perspective is transferable, without independent new experiments or biomedical validation.

articles.title: Physically implemented nonlinear activation functions in optical neural networks
articles.readingBasis: Official article abstract/preview; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: This review compares physical nonlinear activation devices in optical neural networks. It stresses in-situ training to reduce hardware–simulation mismatch and identifies demanding energy targets. The hardware perspective may inform sensor-edge computation, but proposed femtojoule operation is a target rather than a universal demonstrated result.

articles.title: Chemical defects in semiconducting polymers and their impact on reproducibility and device performance
articles.readingBasis: Official article abstract/preview; full text and SI not read
articles.summary: This Perspective links covalent defects in semiconducting polymers to structural and device variability. It compares defect origins, characterization and mitigation across batches. The argument directly informs reproducible flexible-electronics materials, without proving that a single defect-control strategy resolves every device failure.

articles.title: Bioresorbable permanent-magnet beacons for tracking internal biomechanics during free movement
articles.readingBasis: Author-provided manuscript title page, abstract and main-text results; bioRxiv details API and Crossref metadata; SI not read
articles.summary: Aligned iron nanowires form bioresorbable permanent-magnet beacons with remanence of ~30 emu/g. A wearable magnetic-field camera and learned decoding separate implant deformation from changes in reader position and orientation, with a displacement-equivalent mean absolute error of 2.74 μm. Intracranial pressure measurements agree with a wired reference under anaesthesia, while separate freely behaving rat experiments track pressure responses and post-stroke dynamics over multiple days. Simultaneous wired-reference accuracy was not measured during free behaviour. This preprint connects bioresorbable magnetic materials, chipless implants and motion-tolerant biomechanical monitoring; it is a backfill first posted on 19 November 2026 and has not been peer reviewed.
